description: This file defines an API client class for making HTTP GET requests to a backend server in a Flutter application. It manages the base URL via environment variables and performs HTTP requests using Dart's HttpClient.

classes.name: ApiClient
classes.description: Singleton class providing simple HTTP GET request methods with environment-based base URL management.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Performs an HTTP GET request to the specified path with optional query parameters, decodes the JSON response, or throws an exception on failure.
